scientific_protocol: Unchanged: all four arms, six mazes, twenty seeds, T=24/0, budgets, points, hindsight settings and comparisons remain registered.

recovery.cause: one process timeout and six collateral stops
recovery.batch_size_exception: seven retries only; all untouched batches remain twenty jobs
recovery.original_attempts: Preserve every raw artifact, allocation and completion; earliest complete attempt selected, complete duplicates must agree on learning fields.

guards: Preserve STOP until approval and recorded resolution; use the same clean source and frozen binary; mechanically derived retry manifest, node guards, grant and test-only before submission, cumulative allocation admission, no analysis until all identities pass.
scope: This proposal changes only the seven retry allocation limits and allows their recovery batch to contain seven jobs. It does not authorize further increases or new experiments.
